game_title: Loop Choreography – Hollow Log Trail Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sync value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the mushroom ring using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the mushroom ring is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
